edge.title: Exact-2900 run: late Tempered-Polar/brake/u-w retune + eval readouts
edge.summary: Retargets the #30 stack to an exact 2900-step run (train_steps 2900, PowerCool end 3020) and retunes the late phase: Contra-Muon fade stretched to 2750, a Tempered-Polar term (ρ ramped 0→0.05 over 2600–2800) that tilts the polar update slightly back toward the normalized raw momentum, outward radial brake tightened 0.5→0.4 over 2400–2900, and u/w floor raised 0.3825→0.400 over 2400–2800. At evaluation only, the hidden matrices are shifted by −6× an EMA(0.9) of recent per-step weight changes (from step 2500), and at step 2900 all weights are interpolated 7.5% back toward a step-2375 snapshot (θ_eval = 0.925·θ + 0.075·θ_2375); weights are restored after each eval, so training is unaffected.

changes.label: Fixed reference interpolation at 2900
changes.detail: maybe_capture_ref_extrap_state copies all floating-point params to CPU after update 2375; at validations with step ≥ 2900 apply_ref_extrap_weights adds −0.075·(θ − θ_2375), evaluates, then restores.

changes.label: Tail-velocity readout γ=−6
changes.detail: From step 2500 update_tail_velocity keeps v ← 0.9v + 0.1(θ_t − θ_{t−1}) per Muon matrix; every validation ≥ 2500 temporarily adds −6·v (‖v‖ clipped to 1% of ‖θ‖) before evaluating.

changes.label: Late Tempered-Polar (ρ→0.05)
changes.detail: After NS/Aurora, apply_tempered_polar adds ρ·clip(G/‖G‖₄ − polar, ≤0.25‖polar‖₄) and renormalizes to the polar norm; ρ ramps 0→0.05 over 2600–2800, all hidden matrices, applied before the Contra term.

changes.label: Contra-Muon fade extended to 2750
changes.detail: CONTRA_TO_NORMAL_END_STEP 2500→2750 (run env), so −0.2·(1−t/2750) still acts during the late phase.

changes.label: Late radial brake 0.5→0.4
changes.detail: radial_outward_scale_for_step interpolates the outward radial scale from 0.5 at step 2400 to 0.4 at 2900; inward stays 1.0.

changes.label: u/w floor ramp 0.3825→0.400
changes.detail: target_uw_for_step raises the floor linearly over steps 2400–2800 and holds 0.400 (scope all; deficit gate and decay off).

changes.label: Exact-2900 horizon
changes.detail: TRAIN_STEPS 3020→2900 (= claimed step, no early stop) moves the μ cooldown to 2800–2900; SCHEDULE_STEPS 3050→3020 shifts PowerCool 30 steps earlier (Muon LR at 2900 is still ≈2.8% of peak).

changes.label: Env knobs, checkpointing, eval sweeps
changes.detail: Many env-gated options default off in the run (Aurora relax/β decay, agreement shrink, radial adapt, LR late multipliers, train-loss u/w gate, tail-EMA, weight-scale sweeps), plus checkpoint save/resume, data-loader skip and train-loss logging.

edge.parent_check: consistent (built on #30's Aurora stack; parallel to #34/#40, none of whose additions are present)
edge.noise: Large env-var scaffolding for options that are off in the record run, checkpoint save/load and data-loader resume (start_batch=0 reproduces the old stream), an extra per-step all_reduce of the train loss for logging, dense-eval grid reduced to {2900}.

techniques.note: momentum lerp + grad.lerp(buf, μ); 12 NS iters (2, −1.5, 0.5); ×max(1,m/n)^½
SOAP preconditioning of mlp.fc & mlp.proj momentum before NS; freq 10, β2 0.90
attn.v only: SOAP blend 0.95, denom floor 0.55, ungated
−0.2·G/‖G‖₄ term fading linearly to 0 at step 2750
mlp.proj only: K=3 leverage-rebalanced NS rounds, β=0.25
+ρ·clipped(G/‖G‖₄ − polar), ρ 0→0.05 over 2600–2800, cap 0.25; all hidden matrices
outward scale 0.5 → 0.4 over 2400–2900, inward 1.0; post-step radius rescale
lr = min(lr0, c·(3020−t)^1.2) per group, power 1.2
implicit via per-group c: Muon decays from ≈ step 634, AdamW groups from ≈ step 1607
μ 0.85→0.95 over 0–300; 0.95→0.85 over 2800–2900 (completes at the claim)
every param with 'proj' in its name zeroed
eval-only: Muon matrices shifted by −6·EMA_0.9(Δθ) at validations ≥ 2500
eval-only at 2900: θ ← 0.925·θ + 0.075·θ_2375 for all float params

hparams.hidden.optimizer: Muon + SOAP (MLP, V) + Contra + Aurora (mlp.proj) + late Tempered-Polar

mechanisms.name: Tempered-Polar residual
mechanisms.explain: apply_tempered_polar takes the polar update P (Aurora output for mlp.proj) and the Schatten-4-normalized pre-polar momentum N, clips the residual N − P to at most 0.25·‖P‖₄, forms P + ρ·residual and rescales to ‖P‖₄. Since ‖N − P‖₄ is comparable to ‖P‖₄ (~768^¼) the clip typically binds, so at ρ=0.05 the step is ≈(1−ε)·P + ε·N renormalized with ε ≈ 0.013–0.015: a small opposite-sign counterpart of Contra-Muon that slightly re-weights toward dominant singular directions. ρ is 0 before 2600, ramps to 0.05 at 2800 and holds; it is applied before the (by then nearly zero) Contra term.

mechanisms.name: Tail-velocity readout
mechanisms.explain: Starting with the update that ends step 2500, update_tail_velocity stores the previous weights of every Muon matrix and keeps v ← 0.9·v + 0.1·(θ_t − θ_{t−1}). At each validation step ≥ 2500 apply_tail_velocity_weights adds γ·v with γ = −6 (‖v‖ first clipped to 1% of ‖θ‖, which in practice does not bind), i.e. the evaluated weights sit about six averaged steps back along the recent update direction; the shift is removed after validation, so only reported losses change.

mechanisms.name: Fixed reference interpolation
mechanisms.explain: After update 2375 maybe_capture_ref_extrap_state copies every floating-point parameter (embedding, lm head, gains, biases and hidden matrices) to CPU. At validations with step ≥ REF_EXTRAP_APPLY_START_STEP = 2900, apply_ref_extrap_weights sets θ ← θ + γ(θ − θ_2375) with γ = −0.075, i.e. θ_eval = 0.925·θ + 0.075·θ_2375, applied on top of the tail-velocity shift, and both are undone after evaluation.

caveats: The script embedded in the official logs reads these settings from env vars whose in-code defaults differ from the run (defaults: SCHEDULE_STEPS 3050, Contra end 2500, Tempered-Polar ρ=0.05 from step 0 with no ramp, no radial/u-w ramps, tail-velocity and reference interpolation disabled). run.sh, the frozen train_gpt_tail_refinterp_2900.py and the 'Using …' header of all 9 seed logs confirm the values listed here. The table entry omits the step-2375 reference interpolation, which the README calls the main new mechanism; the tail-velocity shift applies to every validation ≥ 2500, not only the last. The tail-velocity clip bounds ‖v‖ before the ×6, so the effective cap is 6% of ‖θ‖. Runs used world_size=1 (GH200).
